house_kharun.name: House Kharûn
house_kharun.lore: The house that sits on the scrubstone fields. Controls the materials that make efficient desalination possible. Player's starting house. Prefers contracts, leverage, and structural advantage over open confrontation.

house_zamath.name: House Zamath
house_zamath.lore: Holds the only remaining forest and the craftsmen who produce witching rods. Closest of the great houses to the Shore Clans. Pragmatic, salt-stained, and willing to deal with people the others prefer to ignore.

house_thalor.name: House Thalor
house_thalor.short_desc: Proud, formal, dependent on the west.
house_thalor.lore: Northern mountain house. Survives on runoff and purchased scrubstone. Proud of its old forms and quietly resentful of the leverage Kharûn holds over its water supply.
house_thalor.flavour: Proud, formal, dependent on the west.

house_veythar.name: House Veythar
house_veythar.lore: Southern mountain house. Deliberately keeps its distance from the main political game. Maintains a militant agrarian order, uses its own water where possible, and prefers to buy what it must from Ghorath rather than Kharûn.

house_ghorath.name: House Ghorath
house_ghorath.lore: The house of the Stronghold. Officially neutral. In practice a clearing house for debts, exiles, information, and people who no longer have a place in the four cities. Useful to everyone and trusted by no one completely.
